raw.name: Blue Stone

dictionary.lore: A stone that glows blue. It holds a powerful spiritual magic, and there are cases of it being used with techniques not seen in Elgaia. It's rare in Grand Gaia and rumor has it that a demon in the Skyhigh Tower in Mistral has them. It requires high skill to process, so there are few who can use them.
